title: Topic 11
japanese_text: ボディビルダーの<u>頂点</u>を決めるボディビル大会では、「<u>技</u>」ともいえるさまざまなポーズを見せ、<u>肉体</u>の<u>迫力</u>を競う。近年その人気は高まっており、<u>芸能人</u>にもボディビルをやっている人をよく見るようになった。
english_translation: At bodybuilding competitions held to determine the top bodybuilders, contestants display a variety of poses that can be called "techniques" to compete on the strength of their physical bodies. The sport's popularity has been growing in recent years, and it is now common to see celebrities doing bodybuilding as well.
